prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most categories, as few kinds of change have at least two tests that agree after noise correction.
Home new_flow and finish redesign changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Home wait_info, sign_in hint, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, and adoption new_flow produced winning tests, though non-winning tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Early predictions (Rounds 1 and 2) were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results.
Round 3 predictions were too low for winning changes, underestimating sign_in hint and choose_path copy tests.
Sign_in reorder changes caused negative effects or showed no clear effect across tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, layout: -0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_flow: +7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +3.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, incentive: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -1.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +1.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Choice Audio Preview Flow: Add interactive sound preview buttons to pet choices during selection so users can hear pet vocalizations before choosing. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.5% with median time 89s; audible feedback increases emotional engagement before generation.)
1: [finish, hint] Desktop Launch Safety Hint: Display a hint on the finish screen explaining where the desktop pet resides and how to reveal it via the system tray. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop and 3 emails about confusion on hiding/controlling pets.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Photo Quality Checklist: Integrate an interactive photo quality checklist on the photo upload screen to guide custom pet image selection. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected results during adoption.)
3: [home, new_screen] Interactive Wait Time Entertainment Screen: Insert a new interactive tips carousel screen before waiting finishes to keep users engaged during long generation times. (why: Home step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing significant drop-off before finishing.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Grid Overview Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a structured grid comparing standard adoption with custom pet generation. (why: Choose path screen has a high mean time of 514s; prior path redesign tests showed strong positive potential.)
5: [finish, wait_info] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Video: Embed a short video preview component on the final screen showing basic pet controls such as hiding, moving, and talking. (why: 3 support messages cited confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to desktop pets after completing onboarding.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Path Option Time Expectation Copy: Update headline and body copy on choose_path screen to state clear time estimates for instant vs custom paths. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s; clear copy updates previously yielded winning test results.)
7: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Desktop Account Benefits Checklist: Switch sign-in screen to a compact layout with a feature checklist emphasizing cloud save and pet protection. (why: 8 emails reported missing pets after re-authenticating; highlighting account benefits reduces sign-in bounce.)

scores.note: Adoption new_flow showed strong past gains (+7.1%) on a step with high drop-off.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users; supported by 6 support emails and copy/hint changes carry low cost.
Addresses support tickets during adoption drop-off using a promising new_flow approach.
Adding a new screen increases friction; new flow/screen experiments have shown poor or negative lift.
Choose_path redesigns historically showed negative noise-corrected impact (-0.5%).
Directly resolves 3 support tickets on the highest drop-off step using embedded UI elements.
Choose_path copy changes consistently win (+3.1% over 2 tests) and require configuration only.
Strong support mail alignment (8 emails) on sign-in step with moderate expected gain.
